body:
Opening an Architecture design draws its flow diagram on the Architecture tab, with a proposal's changes highlighted the same way as on the UI/UX tab.

### Do

- Draw nodes and edges with Lustre, with `data-design-id` on each, so an agent can tell exactly what is meant later.
- Reuse the Contracts page's graph layout rather than adding a second one. It is in `solace-cli/contracts/src/layout.mjs`, as FFI to that app (D-85), so share it without changing how the Contracts page draws.
- Show a proposal's added, removed, changed and moved nodes and edges through the same comparison as task:149943de0d4deccf.
- Dispatch on diagram type, so a later type adds its own drawing.

### Acceptance

- Tests: nodes and edges draw from a design, each carries its ID, and each change kind is marked.
- The Contracts page's tests still pass unchanged.
- One end-to-end check: a human asks the design agent for a flow diagram, it is drawn, accepted and shown in the list.

### Left out

Sequence diagrams and other types, drag and drop, and notes.
title: arch: draw a flow diagram
